guide.title: How to get your file from Instagram

steps.title: Open Accounts Center
steps.body: On your profile tap the menu (≡) and open "Accounts Center".

steps.title: Download your information
steps.body: Go to "Your information and permissions" then "Download your information".

steps.title: Only followers
steps.body: Choose "Some of your information" and only enable "Followers and following".

steps.title: JSON, all time
steps.body: Format JSON, date range "All time" and tap "Create files". You'll get an email.

guide.warning: Important: JSON format (not HTML) and only "Followers and following". If you request everything, the file will weigh gigabytes of photos and we'll reject it.
